coverage: Shared North American boundary config/north_america_bounds.json (lon -180..-15, lat 5..85, 3300x1600). No shoreline cut. Gaps transparent.
display_units: dBZ-equivalent qualitative intensity (IEM domain) + compatible ECCC intensity (outside IEM domain)
eccc_units: rain mm/h, snow cm/h (precipitation RATE, not dBZ — not numerically interchangeable with IEM)
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT OBSERVATION (NEXRAD + ECCC NA radar, 5-6 min mosaic)

iem_effective_domain.note: Effective CONUS NEXRAD network coverage inside the advertised GetCapabilities bbox (lon -171..170, lat 5..70). Authoritative footprint source: IEM WMS GetCapabilities LatLonBoundingBox; effective radar coverage further limited to the WSR-88D network.

precedence: 1) IEM opaque echo pixels inside the IEM effective domain. 2) ECCC rain/snow intensity outside the IEM domain where ECCC dynamic coverage = 1. 3) Transparent elsewhere. Coverage masks (ECCC RADAR_COVERAGE_*), never alpha-zero, decide the domain. Overlapping pixels: IEM wins; ECCC never painted on top of IEM.
source_name: Iowa Environmental Mesonet CONUS NEXRAD N0Q base reflectivity (NOAA WSR-88D) inside its domain + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) outside it
title: LIVE PRECIPITATION — NORTH AMERICA
variable: N0Q base reflectivity dBZ (IEM domain); ECCC precipitation-rate rain/snow mapped to a compatible qualitative intensity (documented, not numerically equal)
visual_note: IEM palette preserved in its domain. ECCC intensities mapped to the same 11-step key qualitatively. Equal colors across the transition do NOT claim identical measurements.
